items.summary: "the biggest thing i'm after is trying to find consistency & ease in the car. there's been a few good races but we've not had the performance to fight for a podium. so yeah, just trying to unlock more from myself and the car, and hopefully the podiums will come as a consequence." https://t.co/bFxqYxIAKx

items.summary: oscar on the penalty 👏🏻 "when the only option to avoid an incident is to cut the track you're not left in a great place. arvid was very robust. he had the right to defend, i think i had the right to that move until the point where i tried to back out, which is when we collided." https://t.co/VPsIt9euJr

items.summary: Q: "do you like to drive in the rain?" oscar: "depends how wet 😁 when you can still see where you're going it's fun. when you need a little extra or something random to happen to have an amazing result, it's a nice position to be in. i don't mind driving in the rain at all!" https://t.co/WMHOJnm72f
